title: Migrate the CAT testing slice into the Lesson Builder as a control-plane-gated feature
summary: Port the adaptive-testing logic prototyped on 2026-07-09 (selector, provisional ability update, readiness gates, results and remediation surfaces) into the NurseStudy app. Derive the blueprint from shared/nclex-rn-2026.ts rather than importing the prototype's duplicate JSON, and build a CAT-grade item pool rather than reusing the linear exemplar items unchanged. Closes the product gap named in PRODUCT_CONSOLIDATION_LOG.md.
acceptance_criteria: A CAT blueprint adapter derives client-needs targets from NCLEX_CATEGORIES in shared/nclex-rn-2026.ts; the prototype's nclex-rn-2026-blueprint.json is not committed as a second source of truth.

A documented mapping exists between the repo's kebab-case category ids and the test plan's category/subcategory pair, and between NCJMM_FUNCTIONS title case and the prototype's snake_case clinical judgment steps.

An item-pool builder produces CAT items with a numeric difficulty in the range -3 to 3, a randomized correct-option position, and per-item distractors; items whose distractors come from the shared placeholder triple are rejected by the readiness gate.
Near-duplicate items generated from the same ClinicalFact under different context phrasings are grouped so the selector treats them as one exposure unit.

lib/cat/selectNextItem, lib/cat/updateAbility, and lib/cat/evaluateGates are ported with unit tests covering under-covered-category selection, ability clamping at -3 and 3, and each blocking gate reason.
CAT readiness is enforced by the eight gates in the prototype spec and reports a machine-readable blocked artifact naming the failing item ids.
A learner can complete a 20-item adaptive session; confirmed answers cannot be changed; results show ability estimate, blueprint coverage, weak concepts, rationales, and linked remediation lessons.
CAT results emit PerformanceSignal records with sourceKind 'quiz' into server/directed-remediation-engine.ts rather than introducing a second remediation path.
The CAT student and educator routes are registered in client/src/lib/mvp-navigation.tsx, per the navigation registry established in PRODUCT_CONSOLIDATION_LOG.md.
npm run check:cat passes, and npm run check:launch and npm run smoke:launch-surfaces still pass.
No CAT surface claims to replicate official NCLEX scoring; the prototype's educational-simulation disclaimer is carried into the UI.
blockers: Item pool is not CAT-ready: all 40 ClinicalFact entries in shared/nclex-rn-2026.ts share one placeholder distractor triple, buildAssessmentItems always places the correct answer at option A, and difficulty is the string 'application' or 'analysis' rather than a number. A CAT selector cannot run on this pool as it stands.

Licensed RN review of the exemplar content is still pending (curriculum_exports/nclex-rn-2026/execution-status.json reports reviewQueue.awaitingLicensedRn = 8, approved = 0). CAT items must not be presented to learners ahead of that review.

Four blueprint fields in the prototype are unverified against the official 2026 RN test plan PDF: timeLimitHours, pretestItems, minimumLengthScoredContentItems, and minimumLengthClinicalJudgmentCaseStudyItems. The stop rules depend on them.
